title: Canonical Successor Process Hardening v1.0 Candidate
purpose: Close systemic weaknesses in successor review, section coverage, delta scheduling, evidence adjudication, implementation validation, retention, release classification, human availability, rollback and process-version binding.

findings.name: SectionUnit tiering
findings.summary: Mechanically define semantic owner units and Tier A/B/C review profiles so exhaustive review is bounded and meaningful.

findings.name: Delta dependency graph
findings.summary: Require dependency/conflict/shared-anchor-contract-invariant relationships and stale dependent review after upstream admission.

findings.name: Review-family diversity accounting
findings.summary: Use lineage/provider/base-model-aware effective independence rather than treating brand count as independent evidence.

findings.name: Implementation validation modes
findings.summary: Make SHADOW_IMPLEMENTATION and MIRROR_VALIDATION explicit with evidence-strength limits.

findings.name: Evidence-class binding
findings.summary: Bind cross-exam/admission decisions to explicit E0-E4 evidence class and invalidate unclassified dispositions.

findings.name: Move equivalence
findings.summary: Require independently reviewed MoveEquivalenceClaim/v1 before predecessor semantics may be classified MOVED.

findings.name: Successor impact classes
findings.summary: Classify PATCH/MINOR/MAJOR by delta count and semantic impact; authority/HSA/topology/material invariant changes are MAJOR.

findings.name: Human availability continuity
findings.summary: Bind protected decisions to HumanAvailabilityWindow/v1 and explicitly fail closed on permanent unavailability until a separately admitted continuity mechanism exists.

findings.name: Canonical rollback
findings.summary: Define governed bounded rollback to immutable predecessor while preserving successor history and receipts.

findings.name: Process version binding
findings.summary: Bind every semantic delta/successor to ProcessVersion/v1; re-review or explicitly grandfather in-flight work after process change.

findings.name: Light non-semantic track
findings.summary: Allow cosmetic/reference/test-only repairs through LIGHT_NON_SEMANTIC/v1 while fail-closed escalating any semantic touch.

findings.name: Configuration-surface coupling
findings.summary: Use GardenConfigSurfaceContracts/v1 plus executable compatibility probes to catch producer/consumer selector/allowlist/budget/privacy shape drift.

candidate_invariants: SPH-INV-001 every canonical review unit is mechanically enumerable and tiered
SPH-INV-002 semantic admission is dependency-consistent at admission time
SPH-INV-003 reviewer independence is lineage-aware rather than brand-counted
SPH-INV-004 semantic admission decisions carry explicit evidence class
SPH-INV-005 predecessor semantic moves require independent equivalence evidence
SPH-INV-006 successor review strength is monotone with semantic impact
SPH-INV-007 protected human authority is never silently transferred by unavailability
SPH-INV-009 every semantic delta and successor binds to one explicit process version
SPH-INV-010 light-track work cannot change semantics
SPH-INV-011 configuration surface expansion cannot silently leave registered consumers on an obsolete shape
candidate_tests: TEST-SPH-001 mechanically enumerate all five-file SectionUnits and fail on ambiguous semantic ownership
TEST-SPH-002 unresolved REQUIRED_BEFORE_ADMISSION dependency blocks admission
TEST-SPH-003 upstream admitted delta marks overlapping pending review STALE_REVIEW absent compatibility evidence
TEST-SPH-004 same-base reviewer aliases cannot satisfy effective independent-family threshold
TEST-SPH-005 semantic disposition lacking E0-E4 evidence class is invalid
TEST-SPH-006 MOVED statement without independent MoveEquivalenceClaim fails predecessor retention
TEST-SPH-007 authority/HSA/topology or material invariant change classifies successor MAJOR
TEST-SPH-008 HUMAN_UNAVAILABLE pauses protected promotion while routine delegated work may continue
TEST-SPH-009 rollback preserves revoked successor receipts and restores one predecessor CURRENT binding
TEST-SPH-010 process-version mismatch forces re-review or explicit grandfather compatibility review
TEST-SPH-011 light-track semantic-touch signal escalates to full semantic review
TEST-SPH-012 authoritative reviewer-policy shape change invalidates stale downstream consumer fingerprint
required_review_before_admission: >=3 effective independent qualified high-quality reviewer families on the same bounded process target, preferably ChatGPT/Gemini/DeepSeek/Qwen
GSL-COMPARE against complete v15.5 evolution/DesignEpoch/authority/HSA/AAP ownership and existing process semantics
adversarial review of permanent-human-unavailability and rollback authority boundaries
shadow or mirror validation for executable portions where applicable
no silent authority transfer or new authority source
do_nothing: The existing process can continue to work, but known systemic failure modes remain: unbounded section sweep semantics, late delta-interaction discovery, correlated reviewer overcounting, ambiguous candidate implementation validation, evidence-class drift, unverifiable MOVED retention, successor-impact concealment, human-unavailability stall ambiguity, missing rollback contract, process-version mixing, non-semantic throughput starvation and configuration producer/consumer drift.
promotion_boundary: Tracking-only candidate. Operational automations and public CI hardening may implement non-canonical safety/process improvements, but this delta does not amend canonical v15.5 or become v15.6 semantics until required review/admission completes.
